note: Native application menu bar -- renders fixed OS-level menu titles (File, Edit, View, Go, Run, Terminal, Help)
Activity bar and secondary action bar -- renders fixed view icons and labels (Explorer, Search, Source Control, Run, Extensions, Accounts, Settings)
Viewlet title bar -- renders fixed view name (e.g., Explorer) and fixed action icons (More, Collapse)
Pane headers in the sidebar -- renders fixed section labels (e.g., Open Editors, Timeline) and fixed action icons
Editor tab bar chrome -- renders fixed action buttons (Close, Split, More); tab labels are masked by default as they echo user file names
Getting Started welcome page -- renders fixed product name, subtitle, and operator-authored category titles and descriptions
Status bar -- renders fixed status indicators and labels (e.g., Remote, Problems, Notifications, Screen Reader Mode)
